text: Use `cmd.HasInheritedFlags()` to assert whether inherited flags exist, and inspect `cmd.InheritedFlags()` to test individual entries or enumerate them (`command.go:1695-1719,1766-1770`). To assert only usable inherited flags, use `cmd.HasAvailableInheritedFlags()`, which excludes hidden or deprecated flags (`command.go:1788-1792`).
